problem_statement: An RTIO context should be able to acquire multiple submission queue events (SQEs) at once in a single batch call. Requesting N events should succeed (return 0) when the context's SQE pool has at least N free events and store the acquired handles into the caller's array; it should fail with -ENOMEM when the pool cannot supply the full request, and on failure no events should be left acquired. Thus acquiring the entire pool then attempting to acquire one more must fail with -ENOMEM, and after dropping all acquired events (rtio_sqe_drop_all) the pool must be fully available again so that a partial acquire succeeds while an over-large request fails.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/rtio/rtio_api -s tests/subsys/rtio/rtio_api/rtio.api -s rtio.api -O twister-out --no-clean -W
